items.difficulty_reason: The small-object argument's one-step functor: defines M(M) as the pushout along the sum of all maps from the test objects M_r, proves M -> M(M) is injective because pushouts preserve injections, proves it is a quasi-isomorphism because the cokernel is isomorphic to the acyclic cokernel of the left vertical arrow, notes property (2) holds by construction, and omits only the routine verification that the recipe is functorial. Retained author proof at lines 4209-4230.
